contexts.text: Good (then) flows through as through a sieve.

A grating, a net-work () = the Sensuous which is the ultimate... This (external) Sensuous was represented by the grating, because it as it were first sifts and discriminates the things which enter man...
Everywhere in the extremes of the body there are reticular forms, and as it were sieves, which discriminate the things coming from the world...
Sift you as wheat (). Explained. AE 820:end.
To sift the nations with the sieve of vanity () = the adulteration of the Word by figments by those in evils.
